prompt:
Use case: product-mockup, source-faithful compositing. Create a refined contemporary retail OUTER PACKAGING study, lightweight translucent soft plastic film, understated dry satin surface, almost invisible clear heat-weld seam with NO padded white piping, NO cloth binding, NO bulky zip track. Visually crisp enough to retain its outline but flexible, not inflated, not rigid acrylic, not a washbag. Image1 provides exact silhouette and orange parenthesis artwork: preserve original horizontal approximately1.40:1 outer silhouette, short flat top/bottom and rounded sides. Orange outside white silhouette in image1 is background, NOT part of bag; only the two interior orange parentheses are printed on clear front. Reduce print visual weight subtly, keep original bracket positions. Complete full frosted back panel with small round hanging hole INSIDE panel, no protruding tab. Fine low-contrast ivory coil zipper located ON TOP gusset, viewed only as a delicate line, not across front face. Clear low-glare front, lightly frosted back and sides. Image2 is exact actual merchandise: preserve actual outline, color, graphic placement. Use one single item only. Gentle diffuse daylight on pale warm-gray matte tabletop, subtle contact shadow, near-frontal with small elevated angle sufficient to see top opening. No hard reflections, no decorative props, no text or dimension labels. Entire package visible with generous photographic margins. S candidate outer size22.4cm wide x16cm high x3.5cm deep, notebook14.8cm wide x10.5cm high x3cm thick. Product width66% of outer width, height66% of outer height. Preserve landscape yellow A6 notebook with horizontal elastic and debossed bunny exactly. Notebook naturally rests near bottom; do not stretch, show tight but breathable margins, no giant empty bag.
Revision: Precise structural correction of image1, keep its lightweight thin translucent soft film, delicate clear seam, low glare, orange brackets, real product appearance and scale, composition and original overall1.40:1 horizontal outline unchanged. Correct zipper and hanging hole relationship: the complete rear sheet extends above the front upper edge, with a round die-cut hole centered INSIDE this rear sheet ABOVE the zipper. The zipper sits on the TOP gusset below the hole, so a hook can pass through rear sheet freely without entering the storage chamber. Lower the front upper edge/zipper about1.5cm while keeping rear outline the same height; use a small elevated view so the top gusset is visible. Hole must clearly be ABOVE zipper, not below; don't add a protruding hanging tab. Do not add thick white piping or bulky fabric zipper binding. Keep item uncompressed, no new text. Image1 otherwise unchanged.
